segments.description: A biotechnology company developing Prime Editing genetic medicines for patients with diseases driven by genetic alterations.
segments.evidence: We are a biotechnology company focused on developing a new class of genetic medicines designed to provide durable, and potentially curative, treatment options for patients with diseases driven by defined genetic alterations, acquired cellular dysfunction, or dysregulated gene expression.
